title: 分化轴两端的成文证据
claim_text: 安全主张在项目安全页与首页横幅各有独立成文条目，构成分化轴一端的可引文本。
quote: OpenBSD believes in strong security. Our aspiration is to be NUMBER ONE in the industry for security (if we are not already there).
notes: 第二源为首页横幅 Only two remote holes in the default install, in a heck of a long time!（公开形态）。首页 ref 未在库内检得，按 new 估，四键待主会话复核。

title: 分化轴两端的成文证据
claim_text: BSD 工程传统被版权政策页明认为 OpenBSD 得以存在的前提，构成分化轴另一端的成文自述。
quote: OpenBSD can exist as it does today because of the example set by the Computer Systems Research Group at Berkeley and the battles which they and others fought to create a Unix source distribution un-encumbered by proprietary code and commercial licensing.
notes: 第二源取 NetBSD About 的 CSRG 致谢段（Additionally, without the University of California, Berkeley's Computer Systems Research Group ... surely would not exist.），以他项目同源表述作旁证。

title: 分化前提的许可与代码基础
claim_text: 伯克利许可的广告条款于 1999 年 7 月 22 日废止，OpenBSD 树内逐字副本已删该条。
quote: Berkeley rescinded the 3rd term (the advertising term) on 22 July 1999. Verbatim copies of the Berkeley license in the OpenBSD tree have that term removed.
notes: 第二源不载日期，只述 UCB moved some time ago to remove the original clause 3；日期仅 policy.html 一源，落块时日期断言应标单源。

title: 分化前提的许可与代码基础
claim_text: ISC 为新代码首选许可，受 GPL 约束的新增代码不再纳入基本系统，许可收敛先于安全主张。
quote: The ISC copyright is functionally equivalent to a two-term BSD copyright with language removed that is made unnecessary by the Berne convention. This is the preferred license for new code incorporated into OpenBSD.
notes: 第二源为目标页同义表述（ISC or Berkeley style licences are preferred, the GPL is not acceptable when adding new code）；两源同域，异文献。

title: 分化轴与同期分支的错位
claim_text: 同期分支自述的重点不在安全轴：FreeBSD 以功能、速度与稳定为焦点，NetBSD 目标序列以稳定快速、可移植与不设负担许可为先。
quote: FreeBSD is an operating system for a variety of platforms which focuses on features, speed, and stability.
notes: 第二源为 NetBSD About 目标条 provides a portable system, which runs on many hardware platforms；NetBSD 亦自述 W^X 等加固特性，故错位应写作排序差异而非独占，落块时须保留此限定。

title: 内存防护的世代叠加
claim_text: 3.3 集成 ProPolice 并默认启用，W^X 首用于 sparc、sparc64、alpha、hppa，构成防护第一代。
quote: Integration of the ProPolice stack protection technology, by Hiroaki Etoh, into the system compiler. This protection is enabled by default.
notes: 第二源取创新清单 Stack protector 条（OpenBSD 3.3 was the first operating system to enable it systemwide by default.）；W^X 四架构清单见 3.3 页同节。

title: 内存防护的世代叠加
claim_text: 3.4 起以 ld.so 随机装载与随机映射提供默认地址随机化，防护序列由此进入第二代。
quote: ld.so(1) on ELF platforms now loads libraries in a random order for greater resistance to attacks. The i386 architecture also maps libraries into somewhat randomized addresses. Together with W^X and ProPolice, these changes increase the difficulty of successfully exploiting an application error, such as a buffer overflow.
notes: 第二源取创新清单 ASLR 条（OpenBSD 3.4 was the first widely used operating system to provide it by default.）；3.4 页原文未用 ASLR 一词，题面不宜直书 ASLR，落块用“地址随机化”。

title: 首页自述中的身份表述
claim_text: 首页自述把安全与可移植、标准化、正确性、集成密码学并列，安全居五项之一而非唯一项。
quote: The OpenBSD project produces a FREE, multi-platform 4.4BSD-based UNIX-like operating system. Our efforts emphasize portability, standardization, correctness, proactive security and integrated cryptography.
doc_date: 2026-10-20（页载当前发行日，页面本身 n.d.）
notes: 第二源 FAQ 第 1 章同句而异序（Our goals place emphasis on correctness, security, standardization, and portability.），两处次序差异本身可作“身份表述未定形”的旁证。

title: 身份表述的自我限定
claim_text: 项目在目标页以 Try 括注、在安全页以有限保证两处措辞，把最安全之说限定为目标而非既成事实。
quote: Pay attention to security problems and fix them before anyone else does. (Try to be the #1 most secure operating system.)
notes: 第二源为安全页 limited guarantee 句（We make a limited guarantee that these problems are of minimal impact and unproven exploitability.）；两处限定层级不同（目标层／保证层），题面以“只作目标”概括时须留正文分辨。

title: 强制的代价：例外清单与开关
claim_text: 6.0 起 W^X 严格默认执行，例外须可执行文件带 PT_OPENBSD_WXNEEDED 标记并置于 wxallowed 挂载的文件系统。
quote: W^X: First used for sparc, sparc64, alpha, and hppa in OpenBSD 3.3. Strictly enforced by default since OpenBSD 6.0: a program can only violate it if the executable is marked with PT_OPENBSD_WXNEEDED and it is located on a filesystem mounted with the wxallowed mount(8) option.
notes: 第二源为 6.0 页同义段并补出安装器行为（the installer mounts the /usr/local filesystem with wxallowed）；例外清单的“清单”面（哪些 ports 违例）未获成文清单，题面不宜作清单解。

title: 安全改造的用户态清理负担
claim_text: xonly 推行前须逐项修复用户态旧写法，清理成本落在源码维护面。
quote: Some architectures now have non-readable code ("xonly"), both from the perspective of userland reading its own memory, or the kernel trying to read memory in a system call. Many sloppy practices in userland code had to be repaired to allow this. The linker option --execute-only is enabled by default.
notes: 未获第二独立来源：6.0 页 still too many ports which violate W^X 属 ports 面邻证，非同一命题；LWN 928668 检索摘要含同段，但页面实取未载该段，不作第二源。落块前须补独立源或并 claim。

title: 代价的承担者与边界说明
claim_text: 项目以“仅最近两个发行获基础系统修复”与“自建并不轻松”两条文，把跟进成本交回用户并划定可接受边界。
quote: Only the two most recent OpenBSD releases receive security and reliability fixes for the base system.
notes: 第二源为安全页自建难度句（building your own system from source code is not trivial; it is over 850MB of source code）；两源同域，异文献，边界属政策声明而非承诺书，落块须避免作法律义务解。

title: 项目本体事件的选取标准
claim_text: 拟证：本卷只收共同体事件，取标准以组织与协作为准。
notes: 属本卷编纂分界的方法题，非外部史实；三轮检索（见 c1-closed-draft）未获可引一手文献，须主会话裁定改写或转例外处置。

title: 制品事件的层级归属
claim_text: 拟证：制品事件按版本层归编年卷，本卷仅取其对共同体的含义。
notes: 同上；唯一依据为本卷节题与 outline.txt 分工注，规则文献不作 DOC_MINE 证据，须裁定。

title: 项目史与编年卷的交界
claim_text: 拟证：交界以事件主体判定，共同体事件入本卷，制品变更归编年卷。
notes: 同上；交界判据只见于分工注，未见外部成文，须裁定。
